clips.note: A boy explains what happened: “I was just standing there.” Ellen jokes that it is a good reason.
around: Cuz I was just standing there.
So, you’ve been dancing for a long time.

clips.line: I don’t really have a good excuse.
clips.note: Someone told him about some books. He still hasn’t read them, and he has no good reason why.
around: and, uh, it’s such a great concept and I should read them.
Um, yeah, I might just order copies after I finish shooting this.

clips.line: I always try to find an excuse, but—
clips.note: He says he always looks for a reason not to do something.

clips.line: And I don’t. That is the easiest excuse in the world.
clips.note: She says this reason is too easy: people use it all the time, so it isn’t a real reason.

clips.line: Really that difficult. Frankly, there’s no excuse for not doing them.
clips.note: He says these things are not really hard, so there is no good reason not to do them.
